prompt: The first-person perspective begins with a steady forward movement along a snow-covered trail in the Mardi Himal Trail, Kaski, Nepal, under a cloudy and foggy night sky. The camera smoothly glides over the uneven terrain, capturing the crunch of snow beneath each step. As the journey progresses, the surrounding trees loom large, their dark silhouettes barely visible through the dense fog that envelops the area. The camera angle remains at eye level, providing an immersive view of the path ahead, which is intermittently illuminated by faint, diffused light filtering through the clouds. The environment is serene yet mysterious, with no other individuals in sight, emphasizing the solitude of the trail. The camera occasionally pans slightly to the left and right, revealing more of the snowy landscape and the sparse vegetation clinging to the rocky outcrops. The muted colors of the night—shades of gray, white, and black—are punctuated by occasional patches of orange light, possibly from distant sources, casting long shadows and adding depth to the scene. The atmosphere remains consistently quiet and undisturbed, with the only sounds being the soft footsteps and the gentle rustling of the wind through the trees.
